name: Yumi Takawa
source: Yamaku counselor and cognitive behavioral therapy specialist, Miss Yumi Takawa is Hanako's therapist. While a kind and gentle woman at heart, Miss Takawa carries her task of supporting Hanako's emotional recovery with unflinching [spoiler]and sometimes blunt[/spoiler] professionalism.
